Dr. Cameron, the new president, in a short talk said that he was going to let the fair grounds committee stand at it was as he thought some kind of a proposition could be worked out for a park and educational center on this property. Only a few days ago, he said, he had been approached with the subject, as the present school buildings were inadequate and before long the citizens would have to look for a site for new buildings. He thought this an ideal one and he believed that May and Elm Courts could be extended to these beautiful grounds which would provide for more homes and other access to the grounds.
